positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Prototyped a library that enables high performance communication of raw packets from a user space application to a Network Interface Controller using a new type of socket introduced into the Linux Kernel called AF_XDP. Afterwards, worked on a Google internal kernel to add features needed to fully integrate the library to a Google internal network platform.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the front-end of an internal application used by Google engineers. Implemented mocks made by the UX designer. Often communicated problems with implementing mocks and would make suggestions to making the design better. 
Worked with Typescript and Angular2 since the design was going to be used to display multiple sets of data without changing the layout.
